note: The suggestion review board. Every suggestion states what it changes, the evidence behind it, the realistic options, impact/effort/risk, and the decision needed. Status values: proposed / under review / approved / rejected / implemented. Suggestions are reviewed here BEFORE implementation — the board is the gate, not a changelog. (Items marked 'implemented' were the founding build's design decisions, recorded so the board starts honest; everything else awaits a choice.)

suggestions.title: Rebuild the landing page as a publication front page
suggestions.what: Lead with the product picks and the four buyer-question guides; move every register/dashboard surface into the footer's single 'Project dashboard' navigation group.
suggestions.evidence: The brief's directive: 'Lead with the products, not with the verification process' and 'make it read like a shop, not an audit'.

options.A: Shop-first front page: picks grid, guide cards, disclosure strip, dashboard in footer.
options.B: Magazine-first front page: guides hero, picks second, dashboard in footer.

suggestions.decision_needed: None — brief directive. Chosen: A. Implemented in the founding build.

suggestions.title: Disclosure strip above the fold on every page, repeated in the footer
suggestions.what: A persistent reader-support + Associates statement strip directly under the masthead, plus the exact required statement in the footer; '(paid link)' labels on product CTAs.
suggestions.evidence: Associates help page S04 requires the statement clearly and conspicuously on the Site, and link-level disclosure that is clear and conspicuous ('They shouldn't have to hunt for it'); FTC Disclosures 101 (S07) requires placement 'hard to miss', warning against disclosures that appear only on profile/about pages or at the end of content.

options.B: Disclosure only on pages containing links.

suggestions.decision_needed: None — compliance requirement. Implemented site-wide and enforced by the automated validator.

suggestions.title: Every outbound product link marked sponsored, driven from one config file
suggestions.what: All product CTAs carry rel='sponsored nofollow noopener', target='_blank', a data-product-intent attribute for click counting, and point at exactly one entry in data/products.json — so a validated Special Link swap later touches one file, not the pages.
suggestions.evidence: Brief directive ('Keep every outbound product link marked as sponsored'); Google's link-marking conventions for sponsored links; S01 Special Links definition.

options.A: Direct CTAs to submitted URLs with sponsored marking + kill switch (chosen, pending G5 verification).
options.B: Hide CTAs entirely until every link is verified.

suggestions.risk: medium — until G5 confirms tracking, clicks cannot be guaranteed to attribute (FLG-003). The kill switch (require_verified_links) is the gate.
suggestions.decision_needed: Owner choice after G5: keep submitted URLs, swap to freshly generated Special Links, or flip the kill switch.

suggestions.title: Publish question-shaped guides (the four working titles), labeled as hypotheses
suggestions.what: Four guides, each around the exact working titles supplied in the brief, with FAQ sections, internal linking, and a visible 'editorial hypothesis — not a popularity claim' note.
suggestions.evidence: Brief directive: 'Lead with useful, human-sounding buyer questions… working titles—not claims about popularity, search volume or product superiority.'

options.A: Publish all four now, measure, then write more (chosen).
options.B: Publish one at a time on a strict cadence.

suggestions.risk: low — titles carry no volume or superiority claims.
suggestions.decision_needed: None. Next-topic selection switches to measured queries after Q-09/Q-10 resolve.

suggestions.title: Ship the RSS feed, sitemap, robots.txt, canonical URLs
suggestions.what: feed.xml (all guides), sitemap.xml (all pages, single canonical host), robots.txt, canonical link elements and JSON-LD on every page; one site for search engines to index.
suggestions.evidence: Brief directives SG-27..SG-30 ('the shipped RSS feed, Search Console, reader capture', 'give search engines one site to index').

options.A: Hand-rolled static feed + sitemap, validated by CI (chosen — deterministic on GitHub Pages).

suggestions.title: Record five defined events now; keep the collector privacy-preserving
suggestions.what: page_view, outbound_product_click, guide_engaged, reader_capture_submitted, dashboard_event_exported — queued locally (no cookies, no fingerprinting, no cross-site identifiers) with a configurable endpoint and an export path on the dashboard.
suggestions.evidence: Brief directive: 'Add a privacy-preserving outbound-click counter and a self-hosted analytics endpoint; record the five defined events.'

options.A: Local queue + configurable endpoint now; endpoint decision later (chosen).
options.B: Wait for the endpoint decision before instrumenting anything.

suggestions.risk: low — the local queue means zero data leaves the visitor's browser until the endpoint exists.

suggestions.title: Start the campaign ledger empty but well-defined
suggestions.what: data/ledger/campaign-ledger.csv ships header-only with a documented schema: timestamp, source, channel, eligible_sessions, clicks, reported_orders, provenance_note, added_by, source_url. Populated only from authorized first-party reports, with a dated provenance trail.
suggestions.evidence: Brief directive, Priority 4: 'Measure before automating optimization… Start with an empty but well-defined campaign ledger… No conversion score or revenue forecast is presented here.'

options.A: CSV with strict schema + validator enforcement (chosen).

suggestions.decision_needed: None. Implemented; the validator fails any build that adds a row without provenance columns.

suggestions.title: DECISION: analytics endpoint hosting
suggestions.what: Choose where events POST to. Options: (A) a tiny self-hosted worker on free-tier serverless (e.g., Cloudflare Workers KV) writing to a KV ledger — cheapest true self-host; (B) a self-hosted container (Plausible/GA4-alternative like Umami) on a small VPS the owner controls; (C) keep local-only queues + periodic manual export from the dashboard (zero infrastructure, zero live measurement).
suggestions.evidence: FLG-002: GitHub Pages cannot host the server side [S10]. The brief requires 'a self-hosted analytics endpoint'.

options.A: Serverless worker + KV store (self-hosted code, managed storage).
options.B: Self-hosted analytics app on a VPS (full control, monthly cost).
options.C: Local queue only + manual exports (no infra, no live data).

suggestions.risk: A/B add a privacy contact point; C delays conversion measurement indefinitely.
suggestions.decision_needed: Owner chooses A, B, or C. Then set analyticsEndpoint and record the choice here.

suggestions.title: Add a compliance gate to the publishing workflow (automate what can be automated; gate what cannot)
suggestions.what: CI validates disclosure presence, sponsored rels, JSON registers, sitemap↔files consistency, and ledger schema on every push; the manual gates (G5 link verification, G6 API policy, G7 endorsement context, G8 claims review) live on compliance/index.html as a checklist that must be walked before any new page or link swap ships.
suggestions.evidence: Brief directive, Priority 5; S01/S02/S04 (disclosure + Special Links), S12/S13 (API policy), S06/S07 (FTC context).

options.A: GitHub Actions gate + manual checklist page (chosen).

suggestions.title: DECISION: brand name + imagery policy
suggestions.what: Confirm the working brand ('ShopNow Kitchen Edit', derived from the tracking ID prefix and the observed niche) or replace it; and confirm imagery policy: AI-generated illustrative scenes (current, labeled), original photography, or licensed stock. Amazon product imagery is only usable through licensed Content formats, so it is not an option for cards [S01, S02].
suggestions.risk: low either way; affects masthead, footer, OG images, canonical host.

suggestions.title: Reader capture wiring (email) — provider + destination
suggestions.what: Pick a static-site-compatible newsletter provider and wire the capture form; keep affiliate links out of email bodies (Participation Requirements clause 6 bars them absent a separate written agreement) [S02].
suggestions.risk: email must stay link-light for compliance; needs a written check before any affiliate email.

suggestions.title: Commit a publishing cadence, then let Search Console choose topics
suggestions.what: Commit to weekly or biweekly guides; after ~30 days of Search Console query data (Q-10), pick topics from measured impressions/queries and add each to the sitemap + feed on publish day.
suggestions.evidence: Brief: 'Set a publishing cadence… turn on real analytics so the next topic is chosen from measured queries instead of instinct.'
suggestions.risk: unsustainable cadence is the main failure mode — choose below capacity.

suggestions.title: Verified comparison table page (gated on Q-03/Q-06)
suggestions.what: A products/comparison.html page with a row per confirmed ASIN — title, price, capacity claim, dishwasher parts, footprint — populated ONLY from Creators API GetItems data or the confirmed listing itself, each cell dated; blank cells stay visibly blank.
suggestions.evidence: Brief: 'It should contain all entries and findings in a simple, easy to read table format'; FLG-005.

options.A: Build the page now with empty-but-scaffolded rows (honest placeholder).
options.B: Wait until API access is live, then build.

suggestions.risk: building too early invites inference; the scaffold must refuse blank-cell inference in CI.

suggestions.title: Seasonal editorial pushes tied to confirmed listings
suggestions.what: Seasonal clusters (holiday counter space, big-game snacks, spring de-clutter) go live only for products whose listings are confirmed [G5]; each seasonal page gets its own JSON-LD, feed item, and sitemap entry.

options.A: Ship seasonal pages gated on verification (chosen shape).
options.B: Ship generic seasonal pages now (risks claims without confirmed products).

suggestions.decision_needed: Pick the first seasonal window after Q-03 resolves.

suggestions.title: Ask-the-reader question box on every guide
suggestions.what: A one-field 'What would you compare next?' box on guide pages feeding the suggestion board queue (local event + endpoint once SG-08 lands), so topic selection has a direct reader input channel alongside Search Console data.
suggestions.evidence: Reader-capture directive; keeps 'publish question-shaped guides' loop honest.
